title: CoinEx Exchange — Hot Wallet Private Key Compromise Analysis
loss_raw: ~$70,000,000 (ETH, TRX, BNB, BTC, SOL, and other assets drained from exchange hot wallets; initial PeckShield estimate ~$54M; full cross-chain accounting by Benzinga/Lazarus attribution analysis ~$70M)
root_cause: CoinEx hot wallet private keys were compromised, allowing the attacker to drain all major hot wallets simultaneously across 9+ chains. The attack pattern, fund routing, and on-chain fingerprints matched Lazarus Group methodology confirmed in FBI/blockchain intelligence analysis.
